similar_task_information.RS: Measured top and bottom discrete candidates only, accompanied by source task description, objective, constraints, and explicit differences from the current task.
similar_task_information.exploitation_after_round50: Same restriction as RS. No Good/Bad Region information.
similar_task_information.round_boundary: after round 50 means rounds >= 51; do not change the existing phase schedule by this policy alone
similar_task_information.source_split: training tasks only; exclude current task and all held-out tasks
similar_task_information.performance_scope: Source-task scores are evidence about the source task only, never target-task measurements.
similar_task_information.difference_analysis: Prompt must require comparison of source and target objectives, constraints, peptide reference or query text/search space, including mismatches and unknowns. The model must adapt a candidate and check current-task feasibility rather than copy blindly.
similar_task_information.analysis_output: Perform difference analysis before proposing; keep response as the existing single-candidate JSON. Do not add a visible rationale or extra output keys.
similar_task_information.peptide: Show source reference sequence and current reference sequence; validate the proposed sequence against CURRENT reference similarity >= 0.75 and all current peptide constraints.
similar_task_information.query: Show source and current query descriptions/text, discrete configuration search spaces, objectives and constraints; do not assume a source configuration is valid or equally effective for the current query.

optimizer_boundary.FSBO_internal_trust_region: Remains controlled by the optimizer and measured outcomes; omitting textual Good/Bad Region summaries does not disable the optimizer trust region.
optimizer_boundary.LLM_action: One discrete feasible candidate; no latent coordinates or region-control commands.

ORPO: The existing audited ORPO pairs and prompts remain intact: good/bad are concrete measured examples, not inferred Good/Bad Regions.
integration_gate: Use the policy in both peptide and query rollout/evaluation builders before launching RL.
Verify source/target task descriptions and machine-generated differences using real task metadata.
Select top/bottom examples from verified feasible training observations only.
Run full prompt token checks after adding retrieval cards, preserving Recent50 and constraints.
Do not claim this policy file or helper is a running RL pipeline.
query_integration: separate follow-up; this campaign trains peptide only

campaign_phase_override.authorized_by: User requested normal prompts for former explore/exploit turns
